NLContextualEmbedding.doc: A model that computes sequences of embedding vectors for natural language utterances.

NLContextualEmbeddingResult.doc: An object that represents the embedding vector result from applying a contextual embedding to a string.

NLEmbedding.doc: A map of strings to vectors, which locates neighboring, similar strings.

NLGazetteer.doc: A collection of terms and their labels, which take precedence over a word tagger.

NLLanguageRecognizer.doc: The language of a body of text.

NLModel.doc: A custom model trained to classify or tag natural language text.

NLModelConfiguration.doc: The configuration parameters of a natural language model.

NLTagger.doc: A tagger that analyzes natural language text.

NLTokenizer.doc: A tokenizer that segments natural language text into semantic units.

NLContextualEmbeddingAssetsResult.doc: The availability of the contextual embedding model assets.

NLDistanceType.doc: The means of calculating a distance between two locations in a text embedding.

NLDistanceTypeCosine.doc: A method of calculating distance by using cosine similarity.

NLModelType.doc: The different types of a natural language model.

NLTaggerAssetsResult.doc: The response to an asset request.

NLTaggerOptions.doc: Constants for linguistic tagger enumeration specifying which tokens to omit and whether to join names.

NLTokenizerAttributes.doc: Hints about the contents of the string for the tokenizer.
